description: Hyperliquid market positioning, by `view`. `open_interest`: open interest per symbol at the latest snapshot beside the venue's own figure, so the two can be reconciled. `symbol_metrics`: the hourly open-interest, position-count and `bias` series (a fraction from -1 to +1) of ONE symbol, all cohorts summed or one cohort sliced; the newest row is `provisional` (the hour in progress). A cohort slice has data from 2026-04-07 (the first hour cohort labels are correct; `data_from`), all cohorts summed the whole history. A `pnl` cohort slice here uses TODAY's grading for past hours (look-ahead): use hl_cohort_metrics with label_basis=point_in_time for research. `size_breakdown`: one symbol's positioning by position-size bucket (ten dollar ranges, empty ones zero-filled). `positions`: individual position rows, current by default or historical with `start` (and optionally `end`; `end` alone is refused; bound it by `symbol` or `wallet`). `positions` is ordered by KEY, NOT by size (current: wallet, symbol, direction; historical: symbol, snapshot time, wallet), because the cursor pages on the primary key: `limit=10` is the first ten wallets in address order, never the ten biggest. For the biggest positions of ONE symbol pass `sort=size` (current only, `limit` at most 500, no `cursor`): rows come biggest first and each carries `account_value`, the wallet's NATIVE perp account value in USD (null when unknown, never 0; a builder DEX's separate account is not in it), `account_mode` (`default`, `unifiedAccount`, `portfolioMargin`, `disabled`) and `whole_account_value`: in the two modes whose margin lives outside the perp account, the native account plus the USDC held outside it, else equal to `account_value`; both null on a row that does not record the mode (before 2026-11-07 20:03 UTC or from the fallback poller); there is no per-position cumulative funding. For market-wide sizes use `size_breakdown`, `open_interest` or hl_cohort_metrics. `indices`: four cohort readings of ONE symbol, all RATIOS from -1 (all short) to +1 (all long), not percents, and null (never 0) when a cohort holds no positions: `latest` is the newest 5-minute snapshot and `series` the settled hourly rows, newest first, data from 2026-04-07 (the first hour cohort labels are correct; `data_from`) (`hours` sizes the window, `limit` caps the rows, `has_more` says older rows exist). `smi` = long share of the 3x smart / 2x smart / smart wallets minus long share of the rekt / 2x rekt / 3x rekt wallets; `wsi` = long share of the 4x whale .. whale wallets minus long share of the 2x shrimp / shrimp wallets; `whale_bias` and `smart_bias` = (long - short) / (long + short) over those whale / smart wallets (`latest` only). `latest.smi` and `latest.smart_bias` rank wallets by today's PnL grading (`latest.label_basis` is `current`), the hourly `series` by each hour's own grading (top-level `label_basis` is `point_in_time`). `large_fills`: one symbol's fills of at least `min_usd` (from $50,000) of the last `hours` (up to 24), newest first, the website's Whale Activity feed: `ts`, `wallet`, `direction` (`buy` | `sell`), `size_token`, `size_usd`, `price`, `order_type` (`market` = crossed the book, `limit` = rested), `size_cohort`, `pnl_cohort` (graded at the fill's own hour where that hour is labelled, else today; `pnl_cohort_basis` says which). The source keeps only the newest 200 fills over $50k per symbol, so on a busy symbol it reaches back minutes, not a day: `covered_from` is how far back the answer reaches (the oldest fill held when `truncated` is true, else the start of the `hours` window) and `truncated` is true when that cap may have cut older fills inside `hours` (they may all be below `min_usd`). `limit` defaults to 200, everything the source holds per symbol; `has_more` is true when a lower `limit` cut matching rows. Liquidations are not flagged. Notional is USD. `hourly`: an hourly panel of up to 64 `symbols` at once, the close (from fills) beside open interest, funding rate and premium (node snapshots averaged over the hour); `rows` are ARRAYS in `columns` order, not objects, `days` (default 120, at most 400) or `start` sizes the window, and `start` / `end` in the answer are the window actually read. `funding_rates`: without `symbol` the board, every perp's latest `funding_rate` (the venue's HOURLY rate as a fraction; Hyperliquid settles every hour, positive = longs pay), `funding_rate_annualized` (x 8760, simple), `premium`, `mid_price` and open interest (`open_interest` in coins, `open_interest_usd`), ranked by `sort` (`oi` default, `rate`, `abs_rate`), `as_of` the newest reading; with `symbol` that perp's hourly history from `data_from`, each hour the MEAN of its ~12 five-minute readings (`n_snapshots`), not the rate settled at the hour's end. Builder-DEX (HIP-3) perps are included; their hours from 2026-04-22 13:00 to 2026-11-03 are the SETTLED rate (rebuilt from the venue's history), `null` where the venue published none. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/{positions/symbols, positions, symbols/hourly, funding-rates} and GET /v1/hl-cohorts/symbols/{symbol}/{metrics, size-breakdown, indices, large-fills}.

axis.description: Cohort ladder: `size` = account-value tiers in USD, `pnl` = percentile rank of cumulative realized PnL (NOT dollars), `pnl_abs` = dollar bands of that same PnL. On `symbol_metrics` omit it to sum all cohorts; with `cohort` it slices one, and a `pnl` slice uses TODAY's grading for past hours (look-ahead: use hl_cohort_metrics with label_basis=point_in_time for research). Default by view: positions size. Used by view: symbol_metrics, positions.

cohort.description: One label on `axis`, spelled exactly as `hl_segments` view=cohorts lists it, e.g. `whale` (size) or `3x smart` (pnl). Omit for all wallets. Used by view: symbol_metrics, positions.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page. Refused with `sort=size`. On `funding_rates` resend the same `symbol`, `sort` and `order`. Used by view: symbol_metrics, positions, funding_rates.

days.description: Window length in days back from `end`, 1 to 400. `start` overrides it. Used by view: hourly.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound, e.g. 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z. On `positions` it needs `start` and is refused without it. On `hourly` it is exclusive and defaults to now. On `funding_rates` it is inclusive and needs `symbol`. Used by view: symbol_metrics, positions, indices, hourly, funding_rates.

hours.description: `indices`: window length in hours when `start` is omitted, ending at `end` or now. `large_fills`: how far back to look, at most 24. Default by view: indices 168, large_fills 24. Max by view: indices 8760, large_fills 24. Used by view: indices, large_fills.

label_basis.description: `current` only: this series resolves the cohort label at query time, so `point_in_time` is refused by name; use hl_cohort_metrics for it. Used by view: symbol_metrics.

limit.description: Rows per page. On `indices`: max hourly rows, newest first; `has_more` says older ones exist, page back with `end` = the oldest `ts` minus 1 second. On `large_fills`: max fills, newest first; the source holds at most 200 per symbol, which is the default, and `has_more` says a lower `limit` cut rows. Default by view: symbol_metrics 500, positions 100, indices 5000, large_fills 200, funding_rates 500. Max by view: symbol_metrics 5000, positions 5000, indices 5000, large_fills 1000, funding_rates 5000. Used by view: symbol_metrics, positions, indices, large_fills, funding_rates.

min_usd.description: `large_fills` only: smallest fill in USD. 50000 is also the minimum: nothing smaller is held. Used by view: large_fills.

open_only.description: `true` (default) = the latest open positions. Passing `start` switches to the historical snapshots whatever this says; `false` without `start` is refused. Used by view: positions.

opened_within.description: Only positions opened within this window: `24h`, `7d`, `30d` or `all`; positions with no known open time are left out of every bounded window. Used by view: symbol_metrics.

order.description: `funding_rates` only: `desc` (default: the board largest first, a history newest hour first) or `asc`. Used by view: funding_rates.

resolution.description: `positions` history only (needs `start`): `5m` = every snapshot, ~5 minutes apart; `1h` = the last snapshot of each hour, ~12x fewer rows. Default `1h` when `wallet` is given, `5m` otherwise; a `5m` read of one wallet is limited to 48 hours. Used by view: positions.

sort.description: `positions`: `size` = the biggest current positions of ONE `symbol` first (by notional, then wallet, then direction), each row carrying the wallet's native `account_value`, `whole_account_value` and `account_mode`. Needs `symbol`, `limit` at most 500, no `cursor` and no `start`/`end`. Omit it for key order. `funding_rates` (the board, no `symbol`): `oi` (open interest in USD, the default), `rate` or `abs_rate` (the size of the rate whatever its sign). Used by view: positions, funding_rates.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. On `positions`, setting it switches to history (`end` alone does not). On `hourly` (also epoch seconds or ms) it is inclusive and overrides `days`. On `funding_rates` it bounds a `symbol`'s history (inclusive) and is refused without `symbol`. Used by view: symbol_metrics, positions, indices, hourly, funding_rates.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. On `positions` it is a filter; bound a historical read by it or by `wallet`. On `funding_rates` it switches from the board of every perp to that perp's hourly history; HIP-3 markets (`xyz:TSLA`) included. Used by view: symbol_metrics, size_breakdown, positions, indices, large_fills, funding_rates. Required by view: symbol_metrics, size_breakdown, indices, large_fills.

symbols.description: Comma-separated perp tickers, e.g. `BTC,ETH,SOL`; at most 64. Used by view: hourly. Required by view: hourly.

view.description: What to read. `open_interest`: open interest per symbol beside the venue's own figure. `symbol_metrics`: the hourly open-interest, position-count and bias series of one symbol. `size_breakdown`: one symbol's positioning by position-size bucket. `positions`: individual position rows in key order (not by size; `sort=size` for the biggest of one symbol), current or historical (historical rows carry `label_causal`, the previous hour's label, for a backtest without lookahead). `indices`: the smart money and whale-vs-shrimp indices plus whale and smart bias of one symbol: the newest snapshot and an hourly series. `large_fills`: one symbol's large fills (from $50k) of the last day, newest first, as the website's Whale Activity feed. `hourly`: hourly close, open interest, funding rate and premium of up to 64 symbols at once. `funding_rates`: the latest funding rate of every perp, or with `symbol` one perp's hourly funding history. Default `open_interest`.

wallet.description: One wallet's positions only. Used by view: positions.
